hero.caption: Saltelva, or Saltdalselva, is a river in Saltdal municipality in Nordland. It concludes Saltdalsfjorden at Rognan. Saltdalselva is part of the Saltdal River system, the third largest river in Nordland county. Watercourse is 78.1 km long, including Lønselva river, and has a catchment area of 1,544 km²

images.filename: Street sign in Saltdal marking Blodveien "the Blood Road".jpg
images.caption: Blodveien is a stretch of road northeast of Rognan in Saltdal in Nordland that was built by prisoners of war during World War II. The road was a new parcel of national road 50 between Rognan and Langset on the east side of Saltdalsfjorden. The specific incident that gave the road its name was a cross of blood that was painted on a rock wall  in June 1943. The blood came from a prisoner was shot by a Wehrmacht soldier, and the cross was painted by his brother.
images.alt: Blodveien is a stretch of road northeast of Rognan in Saltdal in Nordland that was built by prisoners of war during World War II. The road was a new parcel of national road 50 between Rognan and Langset on the east side of Saltdalsfjorden. The specific incident that gave the road its name was a cross of blood that was painted on a rock wall  in June 1943. images.filename: Information board about Skansenøyra nature reserve.jpg
images.caption: Skansenøyra nature reserve is located by Rognan in Saltdal municipality in Nordland, Norway. The nature reserve comprises a delta area in the Saltdalselva outlet in the Saltdalsfjord. The area has an area of 208 acres, of which 15 acres are land area. The area is protected to preserve the most pristine part of an endangered wetland type with great regional conservation value, especially due to its functions for the locality's rich and varied bird life and the area's importance as an excursion area.

images.caption: From the 20th century, engines became commonplace in fishing vessels instead of sails in Norway, and boats became larger. Before 1950, Haagensenverkstedet was one of the few workshops in northern Norway with expertise and equipment for modern boats. The workshop was in operation until the 1960s.

images.caption: View from Reinebringen in the municipality of Moskenes, Nordland, Norway. Reinebringen is a 484-meter-high mountain above the Vestfjord near the fishing village of Reine.
